claims.text_ko: adjusted net income · For the three months ended September 30, 2026: $127.4 million — 회사의 조정 순이익이다
claims.quote: For the three months ended September 30, 2026, the Company had adjusted net income (see Non-IFRS Measures section below) of $127.4 million, or $2.79 basic and $2.49 diluted earnings per share, which excludes from net income (i) a $152.6 million gain on sales of vessels and (ii) a $55.6 million fair value loss on financial liabilities measured at fair value.
claims.period: For the three months ended September 30, 2026
claims.subject: issuer

claims.text_ko: adjusted net income · For the nine months ended September 30, 2026: $521.9 million — 회사의 조정 순이익이다
claims.quote: For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company had adjusted net income (see Non-IFRS Measures section below) of $521.9 million, or $11.30 basic and $10.14 diluted earnings per share, which excludes from net income (i) a $372.6 million gain on sales of vessels, (ii) a $20.7 million write-off of deferred financing fees and debt extinguishment costs (which includes $12.8 million for the make-whole premium on the redemption of the Company’s Senior Unsecured Notes Due 2030), (iii) a $41.8 million fair value loss on financial liabilities measured at fair value, and (iv) $4.0 million of transaction costs related to the second quarter issuances of the Company's Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 (the "Convertible Notes) (described below).
claims.period: For the nine months ended September 30, 2026
claims.subject: issuer
